findings.title: Intermittent TCP partial-read test flake in clio-ops MockEmbed test double
findings.evidence: crates/clio-ops/src/reindex_space_tests.rs:90,143-149: let n = stream.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0); let request = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]); parses request_input_count on a single TCP read without waiting for HTTP headers or Content-Length body completion, falling back to 1 on two-item batches (AmError { code: OutOfRange, message: "embed response count 1 does not match batch size 2" }).
findings.recommendation: Buffer incoming TCP stream bytes until \r\n\r\n and the declared Content-Length body bytes are fully received before parsing the JSON body in MockEmbed.

findings.title: Stdio store-retrieve test relies on test-only in-memory BufRead interceptor rather than background sweeper or subprocess
findings.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/stdio_tests.rs:29-82: DrainBeforeRetrieve implements BufRead to trigger state.drain_index() between store and retrieve frames to avoid sweeper timing dependencies, rather than testing the real background sweeper or subprocess execution (am mcp stdio).
findings.recommendation: Complement the in-memory stdio::serve unit test with an integration-level subprocess test invoking am mcp stdio to test the full runtime binary and background sweeper thread across real OS pipes.

plan_1hr: Harden crates/clio-ops/src/reindex_space_tests.rs::MockEmbed to loop-read until the full HTTP request body is assembled before parsing request_input_count, eliminating the intermittent test flake during parallel workspace test runs.
plan_unlimited: Implement a true subprocess test (am mcp stdio) in crates/clio-mcp/tests/ to exercise the full binary entry point and background sweeper lifecycle over an OS pipe, complementing the in-process stdio::serve unit test.
Consider adding an MCP schema draft for raw conversation ingestion if external non-native callers demonstrate a need for unchunked turn extraction over MCP.
